title: Combine list values
summary: F#: Combine list values. Use 10 as the starting total.
introduction: List.fold carries a result through the list. The starting total is zero here.

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.

blocks.title: Combine list values
blocks.code:
let total = [2; 3; 4] |> List.fold (fun sum n -> sum + n) 0
printfn "%d" total

blocks.text: The fold carries totals 2, 5 and 9 after starting at zero.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The starting value affects the result.
